protocol: operator_collection_protocol_v2.json revision4; unchanged quality, roles, complexity limits and test policy
fitting_weight: source equal, then equal targets within each source; relative squared-error fitting using the preregistered label denominator floors
standardization: training source/target weighted mean and scale only; coefficients exported in raw units
prediction: finite numerical prediction clamped to nonnegative, report unclamped negatives separately
feature_policy: available Query numerical features except the three excluded traces; discard training-constant features; no posterior or source/shape identity

piecewise_ridge.positions: pooled training-only nearest-rank target quantiles j/(k+1)
piecewise_ridge.continuity: independent segment coefficients; no continuity or monotonicity constraint

shallow_tree.training_only_pruning: collapse any subtree whose proposed leaf has fewer than three source groups

width_groups: shared operation model first; only compare <=16 and >16 maximum-operand-width groups if each has >=3 train and >=2 validation source groups; no exact width/shape tables
validation_selection: gate passing source-macro median/P95 and per-operation P95 first; minimum source-macro normalized absolute error, then serialized coefficient/node count and stable candidate order
delay_reserve: maximum positive validation underprediction per selected operation/width group; frozen before test
domain: semantic rules plus training-feature numeric support and per-operation observed target interval, validated held-out sources; unsupported values explicitly uncovered; no exact-shape allowlist
test_gate: one successor freeze binds actual candidate, validation receipt, new features, model/inference sources and sampler; all old and new locked source roles remain; no test-derived retuning
static_unit_bridge: one global nonnegative delay alpha and one global nonnegative area alpha from source-equal train least squares through origin; fixed proxies bound to frozen fixed_op_width_v1.json
quality_source: unchanged source-macro median<=0.15, P95<=0.35, per-operation P95<=0.50; floors10ps/0.01um2
parent: operator_condition_fit_v1.json; original evidence and parameters immutable

separate_reports: unseen exact T on independent sources
candidate_rules: explicit coupled semantic/parameter support justified on validation
prohibited: dropping critical refused sources to pass error gates
removing a gate without error/coverage evidence
independent scalar min/max as sole joint-domain evidence
coverage_validation.current_candidates: regression and demand examples only; no per-view prices or unconditional 44-view qualification
